title: Marketplace channel onboarding and release synchronization
creator: Aisha Nadar
description: Coordinate and execute synchronized listing updates and release notes for Redwood Inference across AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and Google Cloud Marketplace. Scope includes packaging marketplace manifests, legal/compliance sign-offs, usage/pricing alignment with billing, icons/screenshots, consolidated release notes, partner account handoffs, and a post-launch verification checklist. Goal: single coordinated launch window with verifiable rollouts per cloud and a published consolidated release note for customers and partners.
tasks: Confirm marketplace SKUs and pricing parity across clouds (Finance/Billing signoff)
Complete AWS listing package: AMI/Container details, compliance attestations, support contacts
Complete Azure listing package: Offer manifest, plan IDs, marketplace test submission
Complete GCP listing package: Marketplace solution package, license & support config
Design assets: 3 banners per marketplace, 2 screenshots, product icon (DES-3210)
Legal: update CLA and data processing addendum for marketplaces
Engineering: produce test deployment artifacts and sample integration (ENG-4982)
Prepare partner handoff packets and onboarding checklist for channel teams
Schedule synchronized publish window and post-launch verification runbook
acceptance_criteria: All three marketplace listing packages uploaded to vendor portals and accepted for publish or in scheduled publish window
Consolidated release notes published to docs.redwood.ai and linked from each marketplace listing
Billing/SKU parity validated and finance signoff recorded
Design assets approved and attached in each portal
Security and legal signoffs completed and recorded in the launch folder
Post-launch smoke tests (provision, instantiate, inference smoke) pass on each cloud within 4 hours of publish

notes: Decision: Use single set of release notes for all marketplaces with marketplace-specific addenda where required.
Trade-off: Fast coordinated launch reduces time-to-market but increases cross-team coordination overhead; mitigated via fixed deadlines and a dry-run on 2026-03-10.
Follow-up: Post-launch telemetry dashboard to measure provisioning time and first-inference latency per cloud (owner: Observability team).
